children: Overview
U.S. electronic solutions supplier's fiscal Q1 sales rose 10%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA fell yr/yr as lost contribution from the divested dataMate business and investments in talent and capabilities offset higher sales
Company affirmed fiscal 2027 guidance and booked new non-data-center awards representing $75 mln in peak annual revenue
Outlook
Methode affirms fiscal 2027 net sales guidance of $1.025-1.075 bln
Company expects fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA of $72-82 mln
Methode says fiscal 2027 outlook reflects risks from trade, geopolitical and supply chain factors
Result Drivers
INDUSTRIAL SEGMENT GROWTH - Higher sales volumes in Industrial segment, especially data center and lighting products, drove overall sales increase
DATAMATE DIVESTITURE - Sale of the dataMate business reduced Interface revenue and weighed on adjusted EBITDA comparisons
NEW AWARDS - Company booked non-data-center awards representing $75 mln in peak annual revenue and about $400 mln in lifetime revenue
